zh.title: 國籍航空國際航線燃油附加費8月9日起調漲
zh.summary: 交通部民用航空局表示，因近期航空燃油價格上漲，國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自8月9日起調漲。依中油公告油價，短程航線附加費由27.5美元調漲至30美元，長程航線由71.5美元調漲至78美元。民航局已要求業者充分揭露資訊，以維護消費者權益。
body: 交通部民用航空局於8月3日表示，由於近期國際航空燃油價格上漲，國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自2026年8月9日起調漲。
根據中油公司最新公告之國際航線航空燃油價格，油價已由每桶133.29美元調漲至147.57美元，收費基準自第11級距調整為第12級距。國籍航空國際航線客運燃油附加費短程航線將由27.5美元調漲為30美元，長程航線由71.5美元調漲為78美元。
民航局指出，已要求國籍航空公司應以適當方式揭露相關背景資訊，包含油料成本占總成本比例或計算方式等，以維護消費者權益並化解疑慮。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Announces International Airline Fuel Surcharge Increases From August 9
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that passenger fuel surcharges on international flights operated by Taiwanese airlines will increase starting August 9, 2026, due to rising jet fuel prices. Based on international aviation fuel prices announced by CPC Corporation, the surcharge tier moved from level 11 to level 12. Surcharges for short-haul international flights will increase from $27.50 to $30, while long-haul flight surcharges will rise from $71.50 to $78. The aviation authority has asked airlines to disclose relevant information to protect consumer interests.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced on August 3 that international passenger fuel surcharges for domestic airlines will be adjusted upwards starting August 9, 2026, in response to recent increases in jet fuel prices.

According to the jet fuel prices announced by CPC Corporation, international aviation fuel rose from $133.29 to $147.57 per barrel, moving the pricing tier from level 11 to level 12. Consequently, short-haul fuel surcharges on international routes will increase from $27.50 to $30, while long-haul surcharges will rise from $71.50 to $78.

The CAA stated that it has requested airlines to clearly disclose relevant background details, such as the proportion of fuel costs relative to total operational expenses, to ensure consumer transparency.
